snippet.title: coalescent || tidal rapture - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3765790/coalescent__tidal_rapture/

coalescent || tidal rapture is a hypnagogic 3D swimming/sex adventure game about harmonizing and want. Dive into a world of merpeople who are transforming and discovering casual relationships through the eyes of a floater who's just been dumped and refuses to evolve. Told in 3 chapters. 

https://linktr.ee/coalescent
